settings.question: Why does it take 8 to 10 weeks?
settings.answer: Because nothing is made until you order it. Your mattress is built to your chosen size, flown to the UK, and cleared through customs. This is how made-to-order furniture works - the same wait you would expect from a bespoke sofa. Many orders arrive sooner.

settings.question: Can I change my mind after ordering?
settings.answer: Yes. Cancel any time before your mattress is dispatched and we refund you in full, no questions asked. Once it arrives you still have [N] nights.

settings.question: What if it is late?
settings.answer: We give a delivery window rather than a single date because international freight can move. If we are going to miss the window we will tell you before you find out, and you can cancel for a full refund at any point before dispatch.

settings.question: What if I do not like it?
settings.answer: You have a year with us. Feel is discovered over months of use. If it is not right, we send the layer that takes you there, and you keep it, with our compliments. If that still does not settle it, we collect the mattress and refund you in full.

settings.question: How much is a comfort layer?
settings.answer:
GBP 299. A new mattress does not cost GBP 299, which is the point - you refresh the layer that wears rather than replacing the whole bed.

The same layer works on any other mattress as a 10cm topper, so it is not only useful to people who own ours.

settings.question: Is the price negotiable?
settings.answer: No. We sell direct and price the same for everyone, which is how the price stays where it is.

settings.question: Do I pay in full today?
settings.answer: Yes. You pay the full mattress price at checkout. You can spread the cost with Klarna. Cancel any time before dispatch for a full refund.
settings.answer_gb: Yes. You pay the full mattress price at checkout. You can spread the cost with Klarna. Cancel any time before dispatch for a full refund.
settings.answer_ae: Yes. You pay the full mattress price at checkout. You can spread the cost with Tabby or Tamara. Cancel any time before dispatch for a full refund.

settings.question: How does the split payment work?
settings.answer: You pay part today to place the order. The balance is due before dispatch. Cancel any time before dispatch for a full refund of amounts paid.

settings.question: Which size should I choose?
settings.answer: Use the size selector on this page. Dimensions are always shown in centimetres, so measure your bed and match the numbers rather than the name. The size guide has every size in full.

settings.question: What does it feel like?
settings.answer:
Medium to medium firm, and you choose which. Most people want a mattress in that range, so that is where we built ours.

Turn the comfort layer over and it moves between the two. If you want to go further in either direction, a soft or firm comfort layer will take you there.

settings.question: How do I change the firmness?
settings.answer: Unzip the cover, turn the comfort layer over, zip it up. Two minutes, no tools, and it costs nothing. One side is medium, the other is medium firm.

settings.question: What if I want it softer or firmer than that?
settings.answer:
The mattress covers medium to medium firm because that is what most people want. If you want to go outside that, a comfort layer will take you there - softer or firmer, in the same 10cm that already sits inside the mattress.

You do not need to decide now. Sleep on it first.

settings.question: What if my partner and I want different firmnesses?
settings.answer: The flip changes the whole mattress, not one side of it, so you will need to agree. Most couples find one setting works once they have both slept on it for a fortnight. If you cannot agree, tell us within your [N] nights and we will collect it and refund you in full.

settings.question: Will my mattress look exactly like the photographs?
settings.answer:
Close, but not identical. Every mattress is hand-assembled and fabrics are sourced in batches, so the shade of the cover or the side panel can vary very slightly between runs. It is the same difference you would see between two lengths of the same cloth.

What never varies is what is inside it. The spring unit, the comfort layers, the depth, the firmness and the construction are identical in every mattress we make, to the same specification.

If yours arrives and you are not happy with it for any reason, including how it looks, you have [N] nights to tell us and we will collect it and refund you in full.

settings.question: Will I feel my partner moving?
settings.answer:
Much less than on a conventional sprung mattress. Every spring is individually wrapped in its own pocket, so it compresses on its own rather than pulling its neighbours with it. Add 10cm of foam above that and most movement is absorbed before it reaches you.

It is not complete isolation - no sprung mattress is - but if you are currently woken every time your partner turns over, this will be a noticeable change.

settings.title: Measure the sleeping surface
settings.body: Strip the sheets. Measure the mattress itself - width × length - with a tape in centimetres. Do not measure the outer bed frame or headboard.

settings.title: Or measure the base
settings.body: If you are buying for a new bed, measure the usable bed base or slatted area (inside the rails). That is the footprint your mattress must fill.

settings.title: Match width × length
settings.body: Find the listed size whose cm dimensions match your measurement. Ignore marketing names if the centimetres disagree - order by the numbers.

settings.title: Between sizes or custom?
settings.body: If nothing lines up, use Request a size and we will discuss options, lead time, and pricing with you on WhatsApp.

settings.heading: Measure in centimetres. Order the size that matches.
settings.lede: Bed sizes vary between manufacturers. Always trust the centimetre dimensions, not the name on the label.

settings.heading: No two bodies want the same bed.
settings.note:
My family have bad backs. Several of them, across two generations.

I watched them choose a mattress in four minutes with their shoes off, and then live with it for eight years. Not because they were stubborn. Because the alternative was a job nobody has time for.

And no two of them wanted the same bed. The one that suited my father was the one my sister could not sleep on.

A body knows what it needs. It does not know it in four minutes.

So yours arrives medium firm. You live with it over months. You have a year with us. You tell us how it should feel. We adjust it until it is right.
